limitations: The raw browser reports remain in ignored local build/ directories and are SHA-256-bound here; this committed manifest is the redacted portable summary, not a claim that the raw reports are retained in Git.

Upload, scale, development proxy and upgrade browser modes were not run with this final driver; history covers the current SPA route templates but does not replace those modes' separate feature qualification.

The current SPA has no source route or syntax-highlighter dependency; the browser source assertion covers escaped plain-code legacy rendering. A future SPA source/highlighter implementation requires its own CSP browser run.
Successful JSON, SSE, artifact and report download were exercised as fetch/stream/download, not as every possible Document navigation; focused JVM tests cover their security headers.

The bundle emits no worker or downloadable font, so the local worker/font policy bounds were not exercised by runtime browser code. No real workflow execution or full release/CI qualification was performed.
Chrome used test-only --no-sandbox; production server had no development CSP exception.
